Title: 10.1 MC and MI (1)
Description: Master the working principles, construction, and key differences between Moving Coil (MC) and Moving Iron (MI) instruments, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 10.1 PMMC (2)
Description: Learn the construction, torque equations, and working principles of Permanent Magnet Moving Coil (PMMC) instruments, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 10.1 Dynamometer (3)
Description: Learn the working principles, construction, and applications of electrodynamometer-type instruments used to measure AC and DC power, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 10.2 Wattmeters
Description: Learn the construction, circuit connections, and working principles of various wattmeters used for power measurement, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 10.3 phase wattmeter (1)
Description: Learn the construction, wiring connections, and working principles of 3-phase wattmeters for power measurement, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 10.3 Digital Energy meters (2)
Description: Learn the working principles, wiring connections, and digital display parameters of electronic energy meters, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 10.3 Multimeter (3)
Description: Learn how to measure voltage, current, and resistance using a digital and analog multimeter, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 10.3 Digital Frequency Meter (4)
Description: Learn the working principles, circuit connections, and reading methods of digital frequency meters, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 10.4 Tong-tester
Description: Learn how to measure alternating current safely without breaking the circuit using a digital clip-on tong-tester, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 10.5 smartmeter
Description: Learn the working principles, advanced data communication features, and modern connection layouts of electronic smart meters, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 10.6 Extension of range MC voltmeter (1)
Description: Learn how to extend the measuring range of a Moving Coil voltmeter using a series multiplier resistor, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 10.6 Calibration of MI Ammeter (2)
Description: Learn how to test, calibrate, and correct errors in a Moving Iron (MI) ammeter against a standard instrument, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.
